text:
alex: FYI I'm seeing a sustained spike of 500s on the premium-api route-1 since 21:34 UTC. latency creeping too. proposing a quick redirect to fallback-pool for 15m to protect the front door.

maria: can we do a soft-redirect instead of a hard flip? want to preserve telemetry continuity :eyes:

samir: prefer header rewrite at the edge so client host stays the same — smaller blast radius.

alex: good call. plan: insert header `x-rw-route: fallback-vit` and add a temporary match rule that routes those requests to fallback-pool for 15m. rollback = remove the override.

lee: how are we applying it? console toggle or API patch?

alex: will patch via internal admin API `/v1/admin/routes/<id>/overrides`. quick patch and enable.

alex: snippet to apply (example):
```
PATCH /v1/admin/routes/route-123/overrides
{
  "match": {"header": {"name": "x-rw-route", "value": "fallback-vit"}},
  "action": {"route": "fallback-pool", "ttl": 900}
}
```

kai: oncall-bot created incident INC-4321 for the spike.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4321 opened by alex. Runbook: emergency-redirect -> toggle -> monitor. PagerDuty notified.

maria: telemetry to watch: route-1 5xx rate, p99 latency, fallback-pool error/drop rate, cost-per-token trends.

samir: dashboards to pin: infra->gateway->route-1, infra->gateway->fallback-pool, console->rollouts->active-overrides.

lee: double-check match precedence: header override needs higher priority than prefix match or it won't take effect.

alex: verified: header precedence = 30, prefix = 20. good to go.

kai: suggest apply as `enabled: false` first to sanity-check config and compile.

alex: applying disabled override now.

alex: applied override (disabled). config compile passed. enabling in 30s.

maria: enabling.

alex: enabled. routing should propagate in ~5s.

samir: seeing traffic shift. 5xx dropping from ~5.2% -> 0.7% in 20s :tada:

lee: let's keep it for 1 hour and then auto-rollback unless we extend. minimizes human error.

alex: set TTL to 3600 and scheduled a removal job at +60m. console note added with link to INC.

maria: tag this override with cause=upstream-connection-failure and link to the backend logs.

alex: added tags and logs link. also created an eval checkpoint to run smoke tests after rollback.

kai: audit: saved override diff to s3://rw-ops/overrides/INC-4321/172.log

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled rollback job created, will run at 1716004834 UTC. Reply `extend` to postpone.

samir: nice, quick mitigation and tiny blast radius.

lee: postmortem action: add a `dry-enable` button in the console like we used (apply disabled then enable) so it's easier for oncall.

alex: filing ticket for console UX change.

maria: thanks all — will keep monitoring. close thread after metrics stable for 30m.

alex: closing thread; will update the INC if we cancel or when rollback runs.
